hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json) npx prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push.*--force|git\s+push\s+-f'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Force push is not allowed. Use regular push.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push\s.*\s([^[:space:]]*:)?(main|master)(\s|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master is not allowed. Push to your feature branch.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0; }
